name: Doomsday Candle
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A Doomsday Candle stores fire and directs it at those who would disrupt your ritual.  When creating your Circle of Greater Summoning, if your candle is lit then any wayward demons will be burned by its flames!

Containing that fire is not easy, and requires the essence within the scales of a black dragon.  Acquire those scales from a skinner and bring them to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.
narrative.objectives: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, very good. I'll need these to contain the fires of the candle. Now that I have the scales, I'll make the candle and hold onto it until you're ready to begin your ritual for the Circle of Greater Summoning.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you bring the dragonscales, adventurer? I don't want to start on the candle until I have them... or I might blow up the whole camp!
